message.title: PitLog v1.5.17 Released 🚀
message.body:
What's new in v1.5.17:

 - Calendar: Week P&L, Year P&L, and weekly totals column
 - Autocomplete history for Setup, Tags, and Symbol fields
 - Native Save As dialog for exports
 - Improved restore reliability

If you've already purchased PitLog, you don't need a new link — simply use the download link from your original purchase confirmation email and you'll automatically get the latest version.
